mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 3 years, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-driven expansion (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), manufacturing output growth supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth and rising unemployment signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, central bank policy shifts reduce liquidity and increase risk aversion, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.
